hook.say: This morning was about Voxtral 3 pushing voice closer to production with one real-time pipeline for listening, reasoning, tools, and speech. I went back in to check the numbers that matter around that launch.

findings.label: RANK
findings.headline: Independent board puts Voxtral Small 3 at 2.1% WER
findings.detail: OrcaRouter cites Artificial Analysis and places it third, behind Alibaba at 1.7% and Microsoft at 2.0%.
findings.evidence: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3, which puts Mistral's new recogniser third... behind... 1.7% and... 2.0%.
findings.say: First, the independent score is 2.1% word error rate, which puts Voxtral Small 3 in third place, not alone at the top.

findings.label: COST
findings.headline: Realtime transcription is priced at 0.6 cents a minute
findings.detail: That matches OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe and sits below Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live.
findings.evidence: gpt-4o-transcribe and Voxtral Realtime cost $0.006, Gemini 3.5 Transcribe about $0.009.
findings.say: Second, on live transcription price, Voxtral sits at $0.006 a minute, level with OpenAI and below Gemini’s published blended rate.

findings.label: LIMIT
findings.headline: A recent developer comparison lists only 13 streaming languages
findings.detail: The same comparison gives Gemini 85+ languages and highlights Voxtral for teams that may self-host later.
findings.evidence: Voxtral Realtime | $0.006 | 13 ... Gemini 3.5 Transcribe live | About $0.009 | 85+
findings.say: Third, one recent developer comparison lists Voxtral Realtime at 13 streaming languages versus 85 plus for Gemini, so language coverage is still a selection filter.

take.headline: Good model, but workflow still decides
take.say: My take: better voice helps, but production wins when the model, tools, rules, and measurement all hold together.

sources.title: Micdrop — GPT-4o Transcribe vs Gemini vs Voxtral

caption:
This morning: Voxtral 3 made the case that voice is getting better, and the real production bottleneck is the workflow around it.

Three extra numbers: independent ranking shows 2.1% WER and a #3 spot. Live transcription is $0.006 per minute, level with OpenAI and below Gemini’s published blended rate. One recent developer comparison lists 13 streaming languages for Voxtral Realtime versus 85+ for Gemini.

My take: better voice is useful, but workflow still decides whether this becomes an operation or stays a demo.

Comment SDR and I will send you the details by DM.
